title: Make the oversized Clippy JSON fixture detect loss of bounded parsing
outcome: Make the oversized Clippy JSON fixture detect loss of bounded parsing
acceptance: The oversized-record fixture fails if the bounded logical-line discard branch is removed, using a short later warning and a successful build-finished record so complete/truncated/count assertions are not satisfied for unrelated reasons.

Exercise skipping an oversized record and retaining a following valid diagnostic; preserve the raw log and meaningful count/completeness assertions without tests that read Markdown or merely pin implementation text.
